newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares slip back in nervous trade.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares slip back in nervous trade.

text.p: 1653 GMT - Portuguese shares eased back at the close after a nervous session greatly affected by the correction on Wall Street, dealers said. Turnover was just five billion escudos, well down on the recent daily average. Ship repairer Lisnave and Portugal Telecom firmed, but the drop by more than two percent of retail and real estate group Sonae Investimentos weighed on the indices. Lisbon bourse was likely to mirror the trend of European stock exchanges in the coming sessions, with all eyes on Wall Street ahead of the release of U.S. unemployment data on Friday, dealers said. "Our market will follow the others. Investors' interest in Portuguese stocks right now is sporadic and very selective," said one dealer.
